F1.rule: label = 1[A*B + C > T]  (T calibrated for ~50% positive rate)

F2.rule: label = 1[A*B*C - D > T]  (T calibrated for ~50% positive rate)

S1.rule: Causal chain A -> B -> label (B=1.5A+noise; label=1[1.2B+noise>0]). Spur_shortcut correlates with A at rho=+0.9 in train/test, rho=-0.9 in ood_test — a model relying on the shortcut instead of the true causal path (A, B) should degrade on ood_test.

S2.rule: Deeper causal chain A -> B -> C -> label (B=1.3A+noise; C=1.3B+noise; label=1[1.1C+noise>0]). Two shortcut features (Spur1 tied to A, Spur2 tied to B) at rho=+0.85 in train/test, rho=-0.85 in ood_test.

R1.rule: label = 1[(A+B) > 10.01  AND  (C*D) > 18.66], plus 20 pure Gaussian noise columns (noise_1..noise_20) with zero relationship to the label.

R2.rule: label = 1[ ((A>5) XOR (B>5))  AND  (C+D-E) > 5.00 ], plus 100 pure Gaussian noise columns (noise_1..noise_100) with zero relationship to the label.
